root_idea.summary: A food-related root centered on فُومٌ, whose principal lexical interpretations are wheat or garlic.
root_idea.development: The lexical evidence extends from the food noun to bread and bread-making, while also recording related produce, food, dialectal, and transferred uses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The single Quran-attested nominal group is displayed under the normalized citation form فُومٌ.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic phrase وَفُومِهَا, this is one established lexical interpretation of the occurrence at 2:61.
In the Quranic phrase وَفُومِهَا, this is an alternative lexical interpretation of the occurrence at 2:61.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verb, also used in the request فَوِّمُوا لَنَا, “make bread for us.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bread; also grain other than wheat used for making bread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical nominal use, distinct from the two interpretations recorded for the Quranic occurrence.
A dialectal use associated with Syria.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A head or bulb of an onion or garlic.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred nominal use for the head or cluster of the plant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large gobbet or mouthful of food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for a substantial portion of food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An ear of grain or corn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal use in Azd al-Sarāh; also described as a feminine noun of unity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing carried between two fingers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nominal use of فُومَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Into a number of pieces; piece by piece.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adverbially in the expression قَطَعُوا الشَّاةَ فُوَمًا فُوَمًا, “they cut the animal into pieces.”
A derived noun for a seller of the produce denoted by فُومٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fruit seller; reportedly also a seller of sugar.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The fruit-seller usage is separately reported; the sugar-seller interpretation is recorded with an explicit doubt about its genuineness.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form II verb meaning to make bread.
Quranic interpretations and distinct classical nominal branches.
Pointer-only reference to the preceding paragraph.
Seller designations and their reported variants.

cautions: The sole Quranic occurrence is فُومِهَا at 2:61. Lexical evidence supports both garlic and wheat as interpretations, while the supplied contextual gloss reflects the garlic interpretation and does not resolve the lexical dispute.
